About us

Cafeed

We love coffee. But we also love discovering new places, finding favourite little spots and those conversations that make us lose track of time.

Nice to meet you, we're Maris and Felipe! She's a psychologist and a mom. He's a designer who loves drawing with charcoal. We share our life with Haku, our cat, and Mike, our dog, plus a shared passion for music, books, TCGs and, of course, coffee.

Read the whole storyShow less

In fact, coffee shows up in pretty much every moment of ours. Rough day? Coffee. Good day? Coffee too. At home we have our own specialty coffee ritual, but checking out new cafés and finding places that make us want to come back is one of our favourite things to do together.

That's when an idea came up: what if there were a place to bring all of this together? A space to discover cafés, keep our favourite finds and share experiences with other people who also love exploring this world.

And so Cafeed was born. A community for people who like discovering new places, swapping tips and finding out that behind a good cup there can always be a good story.

In the end, we believe good moments can happen with other people or in your own company. And that discovering a new place is even better when you have someone to share it with.

Like the idea? Pull up a chair, order a coffee and make yourself at home. We'd love to have you in this with us!

Hugs,Maris & Felipe.

Run a café?

Make your café stand out to our community.

  • Featured on the map

    Your mug gets a special border and shows up first for people nearby.

  • Sponsored post in the feed

    Share a launch, a discount or that new cake with people in your area.

  • Promotions on your café page

    Anyone who opens your café on the map sees your current promotion: a discount, a new product, an event.

  • A note to your city

    A heads-up in the notifications of people in your city who asked for café tips.
